binary-path.tooltip: Only change this if 'cato-sdp' is not in your PATH, e.g. /opt/catonetworks/cato_client/cato-sdp

show-notifications.description: Show a desktop notification when the connection status changes

debug-mode.tooltip: Logs every cato-sdp invocation (command, exit code, stdout/stderr) to Cinnamon's log. View it with 'journalctl --user -f /usr/bin/cinnamon' or Looking Glass (Alt+F2, lg). Also adds a 'Copy Debug Info' menu entry.
